question: _______ was the first athlete to win an Olympic medal for Sri lanka.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Duncan White.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Major Deshamanya **Duncan White MBE, ED was a Sri Lankan sportsman.
 
• He was the first Ceylonese athlete to win an Olympic medal, winning silver in the 400-metre hurdles at the 1948 Summer Olympi
